note:
A fresh check found these problems in this version. Fix each one, and keep everything that is right:
- Card, wording: 'Waves with higher frequency carry more energy' is an oversimplification. Higher frequency means more energy per photon, but the total energy a wave carries also depends on its intensity: a strong radio signal can carry more energy than weak ultraviolet. Safer wording is 'Higher-frequency waves carry more energy in each tiny packet' or 'can be more energetic', which avoids teaching the photon idea from point 2.

rejected.title: The electromagnetic spectrum
card: Visible light is one part of a family of waves called the electromagnetic spectrum. All of these waves carry energy and can travel through a vacuum, which is empty space with no matter in it.
In order from longest wavelength to shortest, the family is radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays and gamma rays.
Moving along the spectrum from radio waves to gamma rays, the wavelength gets shorter and the frequency gets higher. Waves with higher frequency carry more energy.

All electromagnetic waves travel at the same speed in a vacuum. They differ in wavelength and frequency, which is why they behave differently, such as visible light being seen and X-rays passing through soft tissue.
rejected.remember: Light is one kind of electromagnetic wave. The kinds differ in wavelength and frequency, not in speed in a vacuum.

a.q: Which statement about the electromagnetic spectrum is correct?
opts: Visible light is one of many types of electromagnetic wave
Visible light is the only type that can cross a vacuum
Visible light is the type with the shortest wavelength
Visible light travels faster than radio waves in a vacuum
a.why: Visible light sits in a family with radio waves, X-rays and others. All of them can cross a vacuum and all travel at the same speed there, so light is not special in either way.
a.clue: Think about which waves are in the same family as light.

b.q: Sunlight reaches Earth across the vacuum of space. Which of these also reaches Earth from the Sun in this way, and how does it compare with visible light?
opts: Ultraviolet, with a shorter wavelength than visible light
Ultraviolet, with a longer wavelength than visible light
Infrared, with a higher frequency than visible light
Infrared, moving faster than visible light in a vacuum
b.why: Ultraviolet waves cross a vacuum like all electromagnetic waves, and they lie past violet light, so their wavelength is shorter. Infrared has a lower frequency than visible light, and all these waves travel at the same speed in a vacuum.
b.clue: Check the order of the spectrum and which way wavelength changes.
